provenance.verification_evidence: EB-1 is the optimized defined medium (modified DSM 640): '10 g/L' glucose (wild-type) or '30 g/L' glucose (osmotolerant strains); '900 mg/L NH4Cl'; '80 mg/L MgCl2*6H2O'; '150 mg/L KH2PO4'; '300 mg/L K2HPO4'; '200 mg/L cysteine*HCl'; 500x EB-1 trace-element solution ('1500 mg/L FeCl2*4H2O, 350 mg/L ZnCl2, 50 mg/L MnCl2*4H2O, 3 mg/L H3BO3, 45 mg/L CoCl2*2H2O, 10 mg/L CuCl2*6H2O, 6 mg/L NiCl2*6H2O, 7
provenance.recipe_evidence: Verbatim from Methods (PMC6180601): 'A new medium (EB-1), based on the quantities of various elements in the cell mass of Caldicellulosiruptor, was designed to optimise the concentration of elements. Yeast extract was completely omitted from the EB-1 medium.' Base salts (verbatim): 'supplemented with 80 mg/L MgCl2.6H2O, 900 mg/L NH4Cl, 150 mg/L KH2PO4, 300 mg/L K2HPO4, 200 mg/L cysteine.HCl, 2 mL/L 500x EB-1 trace element solution and 1 mL/L 1000x vitamin solution.' Trace elements (verbatim, 500x stock): 'The 500x EB-1 trace element solution consisted of 1500 mg/L FeCl2.4H2O, 350 mg/L ZnCl2, 5
provenance.base_medium: EB-1 defined medium (element-optimised, yeast-extract-free; a redesign of modified DSM 640 medium for Caldicellulosiruptor saccharolyticus)
provenance.base_medium_reference: Byrne E, Kovacs K, van Niel EWJ, Willquist K, Svensson S-E, Kreuger E. Reduced use of phosphorus and water in sequential dark fermentation and anaerobic digestion of wheat straw... Biotechnol Biofuels. 2018;11:281. doi:10.1186/s13068-018-1280-z (PMC6180601). Trace-element (modified SL-10) and vitamin solutions are cited to ref [36] Pawar & van Niel, Bioresour Technol 2014;169:677-685, doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2014.07.059, and ref [51].

components.name: cyanocobalamin (vitamin B12)

components.mapping_note: [CHEM-B12-01] cbl1 is Cob(I)alamin, the transient reduced Co(I) intracellular redox state of the cofactor -- it is not a dietary or medium B12 species. Cyanocobalamin (C63H88CoN14O14P) has no in_biggr BiGG id (b12 carries no formula and no InChIKey and is absent from BiGGr). adocbl (Adenosylcobalamin, C72H100CoN18O17P, ZIHHMGTYZOSFRC-QRVZQHAISA-N) is a real dietary/coenzyme B12 form present in BiGGr and is recorded as a declared proxy for the vitamer group, not as an exact identity.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
